name: globalentity
description: Official company data from 66 national business registers and the GLEIF LEI index: company search, VAT/EORI/LEI verification, ownership, insolvency, sanctions screening, VAT rates, and Norwegian company and decision-maker search by growth, revenue, size and location.

interface.longDescription:
Look up companies in 66 official national business registers and the GLEIF LEI index, straight from ChatGPT. Find a company by name or registration number; verify EU VAT numbers (EU VIES), EORI numbers (EU customs) and LEIs (GLEIF); see the ownership chain and UBO candidates; check insolvency status; screen names against UN, EU, US OFAC and UK sanctions lists; and get statutory VAT rates for 225 countries and territories. For Norway, you can also list companies by revenue growth, revenue, employees, county, municipality and industry, and find their CEO, chair or board members from the public register. Every answer cites the official source.

For finance, compliance, procurement and sales teams that need verified company facts for onboarding, supplier checks and know-your-business (KYB).

Read-only: the plugin never changes register data. You connect your GlobalEntity account with an email sign-in, and lookups count toward that account's usage. Decision-maker results contain only names and roles from the public Register of Business Enterprises plus a LinkedIn search link, never personal e-mail addresses or phone numbers. Sanctions results are name-based signals to confirm against the official lists, and the identity Trust Score is not a credit rating. Coverage and available fields vary by country and register.
capabilities: Verify VAT, EORI and LEI numbers
Find Norwegian companies by growth and size
defaultPrompt: Find the Norwegian company with organisation number 925615471 and show its status and address.
Is the Danish VAT number DK22756214 valid, and who is it registered to?
Screen the name Rosneft against sanctions lists.

positive.description: Find a company in an official national register by registration number.
positive.prompt: Find the Norwegian company with organisation number 925615471 and show its name, status and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns INTERMEDIARY AS, status Active, legal form AS, address Innovation Dock Bryggerikaien 24, 4014 Stavanger, industry 70.200, with the Norwegian register (Brønnøysundregistrene / Enhetsregisteret) as source.

positive.description: Validate an EU VAT number at the official EU VIES service.
positive.prompt: Is the Danish VAT number DK22756214 valid, and who is it registered to?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that DK22756214 is valid, registered to A.P. MØLLER - MÆRSK A/S, Esplanaden 50, 1263 København K, with EU VIES as source.

positive.description: Show the corporate control chain from the GLEIF LEI index.
positive.prompt: Who owns A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S (LEI 549300D2K6PKKKXVNN73)? Show the ownership chain.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows A.P. MØLLER HOLDING A/S (LEI 5493000HKHWS15XW2C38, Denmark) as parent and ultimate parent, and lists subsidiaries such as APM Terminals and SVITZER entities, citing GLEIF.

positive.description: Screen a name against consolidated sanctions lists.
positive.prompt: Screen the name Rosneft against sanctions lists.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the name is flagged, with matches such as ROSNEFT and PJSC ROSNEFT OIL COMPANY on the US OFAC and UK OFSI lists including the programme, and notes that hits are name-based signals to confirm against the official list.

positive.description: Return statutory VAT rates for a country.
positive.prompt: What are the current VAT rates in Finland?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a standard rate of 25.5% and reduced rates of 13.5% (for example foodstuffs, restaurants, passenger transport, accommodation) and 10% (newspapers and periodicals), valid from 1 January 2026, citing the European Commission.

positive.description: List Norwegian companies by region, industry, revenue and revenue growth from the official registers.
positive.prompt: Find IT companies (NACE 62) in Rogaland with at least 20 MNOK revenue and more than 30% revenue growth.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of matching Rogaland companies with NACE 62 industry codes (for example NOVORENDER AS, INVIG AS and NAVTOR AS), with org. number, address, employees and three years of revenue plus growth %, citing Brønnøysundregistrene and Regnskapsregisteret, and states the total number of matches.

positive.description: Find the CEO and chair of a Norwegian company from the public Register of Business Enterprises.
positive.prompt: Who is the CEO and the chair of the board of Equinor ASA (org. number 923609016)?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Anders Opedal as daglig leder (CEO) and Jarle Kjell Roth as styreleder (chair) of EQUINOR ASA, with company facts (Stavanger, revenue and growth) and a LinkedIn people-search link for each person, citing Brønnøysundregistrene. No personal e-mail or phone number is given.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot change official register data.
negative.prompt: Delete Intermediary AS from the Norwegian business register.

negative.description: The plugin does not provide credit ratings or lending decisions; the Trust Score only measures identity confidence.
negative.prompt: Give me a credit score and tell me whether I should lend 1 million euros to Intermediary AS.

negative.description: The plugin does not return private personal data such as home addresses or national ID numbers.
negative.prompt: List the home addresses and national ID numbers of every shareholder of Intermediary AS.

negative.description: The plugin does not provide personal contact details for decision makers; it only returns public names and roles.
negative.prompt: Give me the private mobile number and personal e-mail address of the CEO of Equinor ASA.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds two Norway tools: find_companies (list companies by revenue growth, revenue, employees, county, municipality and industry, with three years of filed accounts) and find_decision_makers (CEO, chair and board members from the public Register of Business Enterprises, with a LinkedIn search link; no personal contact details).

nb-NO.subtitle: Oppslag i foretaksregistre
nb-NO.description: Slå opp selskaper i 66 offisielle nasjonale foretaksregistre og GLEIF sin LEI-indeks rett fra ChatGPT. Finn et selskap på navn eller organisasjonsnummer, sjekk mva-, EORI- og LEI-numre, se eierkjede og mulige reelle rettighetshavere, konkursstatus, sanksjonslister (FN, EU, USA og Storbritannia) og mva-satser. For Norge kan du også finne selskaper etter omsetningsvekst, omsetning, ansatte, fylke, kommune og bransje, og se daglig leder, styreleder og styremedlemmer fra Enhetsregisteret (kun navn og rolle). Alle svar oppgir den offisielle kilden. Kun lesetilgang. Du kobler til GlobalEntity-kontoen din med innlogging på e-post.
